name: Захист: розмін
description:
If your opponent uses a double attack against you, you have a problem. How can you defend both of your pieces in one move? Trading one of your pieces can sometimes come in handy. After the exchange, you have time to save the other piece.

Look at the examples to see how it works.


What do you have to do?

Trade pieces in order to avoid material loss.

Ask yourself these two questions:

  • Which pieces are attacked?
  • Which attacked piece is in for a trade?

examples.text:
The black rook attacks White's rook and bishop.
White decides to trade rooks.
First, the white rook captures the black rook.
Then, the black knight takes the white rook.
Now White can save his bishop.

Both of White’s knights are threatened.
White decides on a trade: a knight for a bishop.

The knight on d5 takes the bishop on b4 (Nd5xb4) and is recaptured by the pawn.
White can now protect his other knight with the d-pawn.

texts: Two of your pieces are attacked. Avoid losing material by trading one first.
